resolved.title: 增强型for循环
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Enhanced for Loop[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

The[b] enhanced for loop[/b] (sometimes called a "for each" loop) is used to traverse elements in arrays.
The advantages are that it eliminates the possibility of bugs and makes the code easier to read.
[s0l0!-header][b]Example: [/b][/s0l0!-header] [code format="java" codeId="749"]int[ ] primes = {2, 3, 5, 7};

[b]for (int t: primes)[/b] {
   System.out.println(t); 
}

/*
2
3
5
7
*/[/code]
The[b] enhanced for loop[/b] declares a variable of a type compatible with the elements of the array being accessed. The variable will be available within the [b]for [/b]block, and its value will be the same as the current array element.
So, on each iteration of the loop, the variable [b]t [/b]will be equal to the corresponding element in the array.
[note]Notice the [b]colon [/b]after the variable in the syntax.[/note]

resolved.title: 正方形面积
resolved.problem_statement_md:
公司正在为一门几何课程编写一个程序。

该程序将正方形的数量作为第一个输入，创建一个数组，然后将正方形的边长作为其元素。

请写出程序中逐行打印每输入的正方形面积。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Enhanced for Loop[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

Your company is writing a program for a geometry course.
The program takes the number of squares as the first input, creates an array, and then takes the sides of squares as its elements.
Write the part of the program that receives a list of square sides and prints the area of those squares for the user.

[b]Sample Input
[/b]2
3
4

[b]Output
[/b]9
16

[b]Explanation[/b]
In this example we have 2 squares (the first input) and their sides accordingly - 3 and 4 (the second and the third inputs). The area of the first square is 9 (3*3), the second one 16 (4*4).
[note]The area of a square is a square of its edges.[/note]
resolved.hint_md:
- 正方形的面积是其边长的平方。
- 使用`System.out.println` 换行打印面积

testcases.explanation: 在这个例子中，我们有两个正方形（第一个输入），它们的边分别是3和4（第二个和第三个输入）。第一个正方形的面积是9（3 * 3），第二个是16（4 * 4）。
